'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]], [[List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump|Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Executive Order 14257]], [[China–United States trade war]]
***The second of two [[tariff]] rounds go into effect in the [[United States]] containing [[Liberation Day tariffs|country-specific tariffs]] on goods into the country, including a 104% tariff on [[China|Chinese]] imports. The first round of 10% blanket tariffs previously came into effect on April 5. [https://www.reuters.com/world/trumps-latest-tariffs-loom-set-deepen-global-trade-war-2025-04-09/ (Reuters)]
***[[China]]'s [[Ministry of Finance (China)|finance ministry]] announces an increase from the previous 34% tariff to an 84% tariff on all goods imported from the U.S. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cp8vyy35g3mt?post=asset%3Aa5f6fd43-f285-4cef-8549-4b7ac5c517ef (BBC News)]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces he will be raising tariffs on [[Economy of China|Chinese goods]] entering the U.S. to 125% up from 104%, while other countries will have only 10% for 90 days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cp8vyy35g3mt (BBC News)]
***[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] begins suspending orders on various products manufactured in China and other [[Asia]]n economies amid [[trade war]] fears. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-04-09/amazon-cancels-some-inventory-orders-from-china-after-tariffs (Bloomberg)]
***[[Canada]] announces a 25% tariff on certain vehicle imports from the U.S. as retaliation against a previous similar measure from the U.S. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cedyyll7467o (BBC News)] 
***[[European Union]] officials announce a set of retaliatory duties on U.S. imports from 10% to 25% on some U.S. goods. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/live-blog/trump-administration-live-updates-global-tariffs-china-rcna200346#rcrd76703 (NBC News)]
*[[Universal Destinations & Experiences]] formally announces that they have chosen a site near [[Kempston Hardwick]] in [[Bedfordshire]], [[England]], as the location for their [[Universal Studios United Kingdom]] [[resort]]. The [[Amusement park|theme park]] will officially open in 2031 and will be the largest theme park in the UK upon completion. [https://apnews.com/article/universal-theme-park-britain-europe-harry-potter-616ec0d28706470ae92e30b529c955e5 (AP)]
